holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: State Bank of India confirmed dark-web exposure of 3,897 customer records on 16 October 2026, while affirming customer balances remain safe.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 5.02% fund weight, SBI is the fund's largest reported position. Its 3-month return of -6.38% made it one of the largest negative contributors (-0.32%) to portfolio performance.

watch.text: Board meeting on 3 November 2026 to approve Q2 FY27 financial results followed by an analyst meet.

holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for Q2 FY27 reached ₹17,389 crore with revenues increasing to ₹55,992 crore.
ICRA and CARE reaffirmed the bank's credit ratings on 23 October 2026.
Telangana GST appellate authority confirmed a penalty of ₹6,95,418, which the bank plans to appeal.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 4.26% weight, ICICI Bank anchors the fund's 22.9% allocation to Financials. The stock has rebounded 5.77% over the past month.

watch.text: The outcome of the planned appeal against the Telangana GST appellate penalty order.

holdings.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd

what_changed.text: The company entered an agreement to acquire CAE Canada's 50% stake in HATSOFF for nil consideration.
P B Rangarao was appointed Director (Operations) effective 28 October 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Hindustan Aeronautics accounts for 3.76% of the portfolio. Its steady 3-month gain of 4.46% provides defensive exposure within the fund's 20.4% Industrials allocation.

watch.text: Board meeting on 12 November 2026 to consider audited Q2 FY27 financial results.
Closure of the HATSOFF acquisition within the stipulated 60-day timeline.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: TRAI imposed a ₹54.06 lakh financial disincentive for alleged December 2024 non-compliance.
DoT Karnataka levied a ₹2.14 lakh penalty regarding subscriber verification norms.

holdings.why_it_matters: Airtel forms 3.21% of the fund and is its primary Technology allocation (fund sector weight 4.9%). A 1-month gain of 12.33% has supported fund stability.

watch.text: Board meeting on 5 November 2026 to approve Q2 and H1 audited results, followed by an earnings call on 6 November 2026.

holdings.name: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd.

what_changed.text: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 34% and net profit rose 80% to ₹63 crore.
The order book surpassed ₹2,000 crore as commercial operations commenced at Sangli and Türkiye facilities.

holdings.why_it_matters: Quality Power is the fund's top 3-month contributor (+0.728%), delivering a 23.12% return on a 3.15% fund weight.

watch.text: Q2 FY27 earnings conference call scheduled for 2 November 2026.

holdings.name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd

what_changed.text: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 24% to ₹11,340 crore and net profit rose 18% to ₹3,682 crore.
Management raised full-year FY27 guidance and expanded capex plans.
The company placed a $3.3 billion bid to acquire Evos Terminals.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.95% weight, Adani Ports added 0.267% in estimated 3-month portfolio contribution via a 9.05% return.

watch.text: Progress and potential closing of the $3.3 billion acquisition bid for Evos Terminals.

holdings.name: UNO Minda Ltd

what_changed.text: Uno Minda issued ₹100 crore in commercial paper maturing on 15 December 2026.
The company set a target to nearly double revenue to ₹40,000 crore by FY30.

expected.text: Management targets revenue of ₹40,000 crore by FY30.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.83% weight, Uno Minda's 3-month decline of -8.3% has dragged performance within the Consumer Discretionary bucket (12.2% of fund).

watch.text: Board meeting and earnings call rescheduled to 5 November 2026 to review Q2 FY27 results.

holdings.name: Balrampur Chini Mills Ltd

what_changed.text: The central government halted the diversion of sugar to ethanol, prompting sharp corrections across sugar industry equities.

holdings.why_it_matters: Balrampur Chini carries a 2.81% fund weight. Policy changes on ethanol diversion contributed to an 11.07% drop over the past month.

watch.text: Board meeting on 4 November 2026 to consider Q2 FY27 results and an interim dividend.

holdings.name: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd

what_changed.text: Q2 FY27 net profit declined 32% to ₹913 crore on lower revenue.
The USFDA classified the inspection of its FTO-SEZ Process Unit-02 as Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) and officially closed the inspection.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 2.81% of the fund, Dr. Reddy's delivered a 17.76% 3-month return, adding 0.499% to the portfolio's return.

watch.text: Operational recovery following the closure of the USFDA inspection at FTO-SEZ Unit-02.

holdings.name: LG Electronics India Ltd.

what_changed.text: Customs authorities raised a ₹61.3 lakh duty demand along with a ₹40 lakh fine and ₹5 lakh penalty on reclassified signage imports.
The company launched a 115-inch QNED evo AI Mini LED TV in India priced from ₹14,99,990.

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounting for 2.74% of the fund, LG Electronics returned 11.47% over 3 months, generating 0.314% in estimated fund contribution.

watch.text: Board meeting on 5 November 2026 and earnings call on 6 November 2026 for Q2 and H1 FY27 results.

portfolio.statement: The portfolio is oriented around Financials (22.9%) and Industrials (20.4%), together making up over 43% of total assets.
interp: Capital goods, infrastructure, and equipment holdings led performance over the past quarter.
Weakness in state banking and agricultural materials has acted as a primary drag on 3-month fund returns (-4.16%).
portfolio.line: Industrial momentum offset large-cap banking and sugar policy headwinds.

drivers.text: Quality Power delivered a 23.12% 3-month return following an 80% surge in Q2 PAT and facility expansions, contributing 0.728% to the fund.
State Bank of India detracted 0.32% from fund performance over 3 months as shares fell 6.38% amid dark-web data breach disclosures.
Adani Ports gained 9.05% over 3 months as Q2 profit reached ₹3,682 crore and full-year FY27 guidance was raised.

themes.title: Power Equipment & Infrastructure Expansion
themes.text: Exposure across manufacturing, defense, and ports captured strong order inflows and capacity additions.

Dr. Reddy's Q2 profit decline of 32% alongside the closure of the USFDA inspection at Unit-02.

could_change.text: Any reversal or adjustment to the central government's halt on sugar diversion to ethanol directly alters revenue streams for Balrampur Chini Mills.

could_change.text: The outcome of Adani Ports' $3.3 billion bid for Evos Terminals could alter leverage and foreign asset exposure.
